defect: The rewrite calls ErrorIfTypeExists(MAXIMUM_LINE_SIZE) on the sniffer's own error_handler instead of best_candidate->error_handler, so maximum-line-size errors recorded by the best candidate are no longer raised.
reason: The removed loop iterated best_candidate->error_handler->errors, the added line checks a different handler, and the fix only changes the receiver back to best_candidate->error_handler.

defect: The new parallel R data.frame scan runs R API calls (VECTOR_ELT, INTEGER_POINTER/NUMERIC_POINTER, STRING_ELT/CHAR) concurrently from DuckDB worker threads, although the R API is not thread-safe.
reason: The same author reverted the parallel DF scan the next day under 'Fixes for arrow scan/DF scan', and the later in-tree parallel scan fetches all column data pointers in bind on the main thread, which points to thread-unsafe R access in the added code.

defect: BindCopyOptions binds every option expression, but a bare * (for example FORCE_QUOTE *), which the old grammar turned into a '*' string, now becomes a StarExpression that cannot be bound, so a previously supported COPY option breaks.
reason: The fix adds the special case that turns a raw * back into the '*' literal before binding, which repairs a regression in the option binding this change added; seeing it needs the grammar/transform change in other files.

defect: The refactor has Connection::OpenAppender lock context_lock by hand before constructing the Appender (whose constructor can throw, e.g. on an unknown table) and unlock it only in CloseAppender, so an exception leaves the connection's lock held and the connection deadlocks.
reason: The manual lock/unlock with the 'TODO what about exceptions in appender?' note was added by this commit in connection.cpp, and the fix moves a unique_lock into the Appender through the constructor signature this change introduced.

defect: Analysis sampling wraps the whole per-vector loop, so unsampled vectors skip the STRING_BLOCK_LIMIT check (FSST can be chosen for strings too large for it) and a column whose vectors are all unsampled gives an empty symbol table and a tiny estimate.
reason: The fix always runs the size check, samples only the string collection, and forces sampling until a valid string has been seen, repairing exactly the sampling condition this change added.

defect: The new IN evaluation calls VectorOperations::Or(result, comp_res, result) with the output aliased to the left input, while the Or kernel overwrites result data before reading the left value for the null mask, giving wrong results (seen on g++).
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added aliased call with a copy into a temporary; seeing that Or does not support in-place use needs vector_operations.cpp.

defect: The re-enabled LocalStorage::Scan builds a default-constructed SelectionVector (null buffer) and calls set_index on it when the chunk has deleted entries, writing through a null pointer.
reason: The fix gives the selection vector a STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE buffer and applies it with Slice; before this change the function only threw NotImplemented, so the null write came in with these lines (SelectionVector's null default is in its header).

defect: The fake constant group for implicit aggregation is pushed into parent->groups inside the per-execution operator-state constructor, so a second state (e.g. an aggregate in a subquery) sees one group, sets is_implicit_aggr = false and loses implicit-aggregate behaviour.
reason: The fix moves the same block into PhysicalAggregate::Initialize so it runs once per operator, repairing the state-constructor mutation this change added.

defect: Database::Close dereferences the result of Connection::Unwrap(default_connection) without a null check, so closing a database whose default_connection is not a wrapped connection (e.g. missing) segfaults.
reason: The fix 'fix segfault' only adds the missing null check on Unwrap in the block this change added.

defect: The new C API declaration is duckdb_get_list_size() with no parameter, while the implementation and tests use duckdb_get_list_size(duckdb_value value), which breaks the public interface and the build (the extern C declarations conflict).
reason: The fix corrects the declaration this change added (from a JSON entry missing its params) to take duckdb_value value.

defect: The added DEBUG block asserts that every projection binding in columns_idx lies in distinct_group, but columns_idx holds bindings with the projection's table index, so in debug builds the assertion fails whenever a projection references only part of a distinct group.
reason: The fix deletes this added assertion and replaces it with a real membership check; the bindings with differing table indexes are visible in the shown context.

defect: The new Pipeline::IsOrderDependent dereferences sink unconditionally, but the same commit calls it from PipelineExecutor, which also handles pipelines without a sink, so those pipelines crash with a null dereference.
reason: The fix adds exactly the missing null check on sink; the sink-less caller is in pipeline_executor.cpp.

defect: Join condition columns are left to be compressed generically when each side's own-statistics compress expression has the same return type, but each side is compressed with different statistics (different offsets), so equality comparisons in the join go wrong; it also dereferences a possibly null GetCompressExpression result.
reason: The fix compresses both sides with merged statistics and checks for a null compress expression, repairing the condition this change added; how GetCompressExpression encodes values and when it returns null is in other files.

defect: The new overflow-checked range computation calls TrySubtractOperator::Operation(min, max, range) with the operands swapped, so the range is negative (wrapping to a huge unsigned value) or underflows, and the cast-to-smallest-type compression never applies except when min == max.
reason: Besides the pre-existing hugeint problem, the fix swaps the operands to (max, min) in the line this change added; the effect is a silently disabled optimisation rather than wrong results.

defect: The change adds #include <duckdb/common/enums/set_operation_type.hpp> with angle brackets, which scripts/amalgamation.py (it only inlines quoted includes) leaves in duckdb.cpp, breaking the amalgamation build used by the Python package.
reason: The fix switches the include to quotes (and drops an unused include); the build break needs the amalgamation script to see.

defect: Replacing the loop bound with the literal 2 leaves n_children used only inside D_ASSERT, an unused variable in release builds that fails the main-branch release CI built with TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS and FORCE_WARN_UNUSED (-Wunused -Werror).
reason: The fix, made the day after this change reached main via PR #9836, puts n_children back into the loop bound, repairing the unused variable this change created.

defect: To fix a leak, the test replaces new int32_t[n] with a variable-length array int32_t keys[n] (n not a compile-time constant), which is not standard C++ and fails to compile on MSVC (the VS 2017 CI job).
reason: The fix reverts the added VLA to heap allocation (with an explicit release), repairing the non-portable line this change added.

defect: In the new optimizer, after erasing an entry ClearExpressions (and the GET case) looks up ref_map by the shifted index col_idx instead of the original index col_idx + offset, so it removes or remaps the wrong columns; it also prunes projections under set operations, which reference columns by position.
reason: The fix changes the lookup to col_idx + offset and adds explicit UNION/EXCEPT/INTERSECT handling, repairing logic in this newly added file.
